sections.title: OVERNIGHT MAP
sections.content:
Risk-off creeping in quietly. VIX jumped 6.9% to 18.38 — elevated but not panic. USD/KRW +1% as Korea's won weakens, a mild macro stress signal. Equities essentially flat on the night despite the options market getting more expensive.

S&P +0.19%. Nasdaq +0.10%. Dow +0.19%.

sections.title: MARKET NEWS
sections.content:
US jobs data came in mixed — initial claims rose slightly, continuing claims remain elevated. Nothing catastrophic but the trend is worth watching.
China Caixin services PMI missed expectations, adding to growth concern for the second consecutive month.

sections.title: ACTION BOARD
sections.content:
Opportunity: DXYZ is running on a single headline; if you want to trim into strength, this is the tape.
Risk: VIX recharged to 18.38 — elevated vol means options costs are rising portfolio-wide; NET and expensive software names remain exposed to any macro wobble.
Research: How much of the MU/NVDA AI capex trade is still flowing vs. peaking? The positioning suggests room to run but the VIX move says the market is getting nervous about it.
